sights.n: Rokugō no Mori — 'Kita no Kuni kara' location (麓郷の森)
sights.w: Conifer forest in Furano's Rokugō valley where the Kuroita family's log cabin and Gorō's windmill 'third house' from Kita no Kuni kara still stand as the drama left them.
sights.anime: Kita no Kuni kara (北の国から) — pop culture: Kuramoto Sō's 1981–2002 Fuji TV drama, Japan's best-loved TV saga, filmed in Rokugō — the Kuroita log cabin and Gorō's windmill house are preserved here

sights.n: Gorō's Stone House — 'Kita no Kuni kara' (五郎の石の家・最初の家)
sights.w: The stone house Kuroita Gorō builds from field stones in Kita no Kuni kara '89 Kikyō, beside the family's very first house — the drama's emotional centre.
sights.anime: Kita no Kuni kara (北の国から) — pop culture: Kuramoto Sō's 1981–2002 Fuji TV drama, Japan's best-loved TV saga, filmed in Rokugō — Gorō's stone house from '89 Kikyō
